Author: Raj Beer Singh
Bench: Raj Beer Singh
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 77
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 12261 of 2023
Applicant :- Imran
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Shahabuddin,Faizan Habeeb
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the entire record.

The present bail application has been filed by the applicant in case crime No. 11/2023, under Sections 452, 376, 313, 323, 504 IPC, police station Tanda, District Rampur with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant-accused is innocent and he has not committed any offence.
It was submitted that the prosecutrix is a mature and married lady, aged about 21 years.

The first information report was lodged by the prosecutrix, alleging that while her husband was in jail, applicant has developed intimacy with her and on pretext of marriage,
he established physical relations with her and out of that relationship, a child was also born to her but later on applicant has assaulted the prosecutrix and refused to marry with her.

It was pointed Imran vs State Of U.P. on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/2938037/
1 out that in her statement, recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C., prosecutrix has repeated the same version but in her statement, recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., she has stated that applicant used to talk with her since last two years and he has promised to marry with her and that she has one child from her relation with applicant.
She has further stated that her husband has divorced her and that applicant is saying that he would marry with her.
It was submitted that prosecutrix was a consenting party and that in view of her statement, recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., no case is made out against the applicant.
There is long and undue delay in lodging of the first information report.

Lastly, it was submitted that the applicant is in judicial custody since 30.01.2023, having no criminal history, and that in case, applicant is enlarged on bail, the applicant will not misuse the liberty of bail.
Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail.

Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, facts of the case, nature of allegations, period of custody and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the view that a case for bail is made out.
Hence, the bail application is hereby allowed.

Let the applicant Imran involved in the aforesaid crime be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two local sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of court concerned subject to the following conditions:
1. The applicant will not tamper with the evidence during trial.
2. The applicant will not pressurize/intimidate the prosecution witnesses.
3. The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
4. The applicant will not try to contact, threat or otherwise influence the complainant or any of the witness of the case.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel the bail of applicant, in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 21.4.2023 Anand  Imran vs State Of U.P. on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/2938037/
